files.description: 27-page PDF containing the EHI export documentation: overview, step-by-step export instructions with screenshots, and data dictionary tables for 16 patient data entities (demographics, medications, allergies, appointments, complaints, diagnosis, documents/images, immunization, insurances, contact, consent, education, patient notes, payments, social history, vitals). The PDF appears truncated — TOC lists Provider Note (section 3.15) and Encounter (section 3.18) sections that are absent from the document.
Structured JSON extraction of all data dictionary tables from the PDF. Contains 16 entities with 401 total fields, each with field name, data type, and description.
Extraction statistics: entity counts, field counts per entity, and list of missing sections (Provider Note and Encounter).
Bun TypeScript script that extracts structured data dictionary from the PDF using pdftotext -layout.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input/output files, known limitations.
